free_tier_limits: Hobby: 200 projects; 100 deployments/day; 1 concurrent build; 6,000 build minutes/month; 1M invocations/month; 100 GB Fast Data Transfer/month.
rate_limits: Published per action and scope; examples include domain deletion 60/60s and Hobby builds 32/3600s. Responses expose X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset.
resolution_notes: auth_type: other—authentication is a Bearer Vercel Access Token; OAuth can also issue one: https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api. free_tier_limits: replace unknown with published Hobby limits: https://vercel.com/docs/limits. rate_limits: replace not published; action/scope limits and response headers are documented: https://vercel.com/docs/limits. cors: no—Vercel instructs callers to use server-side code to avoid CORS and token exposure: https://vercel.com/docs/integrations/create-integration/vercel-api-integrations
